mapper.select: select count(*) from warehouse where status != 'DISABLED'
select count(*) from sensor_data where date(collected_at) = curdate()

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' ', sm.metric_name, ' 接近阈值') from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where sm.max_threshold is not null and sd.metric_value >= sm.max_threshold * 0.9 order by sd.collected_at desc limit 5
